title: After Action Report
open: You've got enough to make a case. Walk it to me like I wasn't there.

clearance.title: Field clearance earned
lines: That's a case I can take. The hollow taught you how to look, measure, and change your mind when the land disagreed.
High Country will ask you to work out where you are. The road is open when you want the mountains.

moreEvidence.title: More evidence needed
moreEvidence.lead: Not a restart. The hollow still has a hole in the case. Go back to the work that isn't in the tablet yet.

items.stem: At the boulder that doesn't match the hill, what actually belongs in the tablet?

choices.label: The boulder has a different color and grain from the nearby hill rock.
The boulder was carried here — that's what I saw.
Naming it was the observation.
I could tell from the station porch.

items.stem: What did the runoff table actually show?

choices.label: Steeper slope, same water, shorter times — that's the fair comparison.
The extra water run proves slope doesn't matter.
One steep run was enough.
The table is just a toy; the creek is different so the numbers don't count.

items.stem: Why was part of Pine Creek muddier this morning?

choices.label: Rain on a loose steep slope, then Fox Run, then Pine Creek.
It rained, so the whole creek is muddier.
The marsh is always brown, so the marsh did it.
Atmosphere, water, and rock were all involved; the willows were in the way, not the cause.

items.stem: Last night is one clock. What about the boulder and the scraped face?

choices.label: Last night's bar is the creek. The mismatched boulder needs a longer clock.
One process did all of it.
It's a glacier because this is Earth Science.
Last night's rain made the boulder too.

items.stem: If we went back to the station reach, what should still be true?

choices.label: It should still be relatively clear compared with the join.
The whole creek should look the same if it rained.
Whatever I pick is fine — I already walked there.
I don't need the notes. I remember the answer.

retry.stem: What can you still point to on the boulder itself?

choices.label: Color and grain that don't match the hill rock.
The carrying event — I watched it.
The scientific name is the observation.

retry.stem: Which runoff-table claim can your fair runs actually carry?

choices.label: Same water, steeper channel, shorter times.
Extra water is the slope test.
The first steep number is the pattern.
